example_sentences_in_bangla: বইয়ে সংলাপগুলো কাকপদ ব্যবহার করে চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Write his statement within quotation marks.
The dialogues in the book are marked with quotes.
history: The term originates from the visual resemblance of quotation marks to the feet of a crow, a common bird in Bengali rural life.
note: This is more of a linguistic term than a traditional proverb, but used idiomatically in writing contexts.
